generator: perf record -e cpu-clock -F 999 --call-graph=fp on the build's CPUs over one build; tokio worker samples whose call stack has a take_effects frame (all of them under next-api's take_effects of the entrypoints operation); cpuS = those samples / 999; firstS/lastS = the first and last such sample, in seconds after the build's first worker sample; threads = distinct worker threads among them; lockShare = the share of them with a lock or scheduler frame (lock_task_and_optional_reader, lock_exclusive_slow, lock_slow, unlock_exclusive_slow, futex, _raw_spin_unlock_irqrestore, __schedule, finish_task_switch, sched_yield) among their 12 innermost frames
build: drift-monolith. warm: the unedited app's cold build output (cache included) restored, then one feature module edited to add a new import, built with the same binding; cold: no .next. Page-data workers matched to the CPUs; TURBO_ENGINE_IGNORE_DIRTY=1
bindingBuild: next-napi-bindings from vercel/next.js v16.4.0 plus the named candidates' patches, cargo --release, LTO off, 16 codegen units, RUSTFLAGS -Cforce-frame-pointers=yes (otherwise the same build as the bindings.json entry of the name without -fp)
note: profiles: where CPU went in one build each, not timing comparisons
